purpose: Per-command TUI/GUI/CLI coverage ledger for program #228 (TUI-first-class plugin surface). Foundation designed in #229; implementation tickets #230-#233; acceptance #234.

provides: raw-mode UTF-8-safe key parsing with bracketed paste (src/input.ts)
diff renderer: alternate screen, cursor addressing, synchronized output, NO_COLOR/TERM=dumb/ASCII degradation, Unicode-width truncation (src/screen.ts, src/unicode.ts, src/ansi.ts)
shared components: SelectList, DetailView, TextInput/PromptView, ConfirmView, HelpView (src/components.ts)
TuiApp screen-stack shell with reserved keys and confirm/prompt/select/task APIs (src/app.ts)
safety helpers: untrusted-text sanitization (CSI/OSC/DCS + bidi marks), bounded buffers, throttle, spawn-without-shell (src/safety.ts)

verification.unit_tests: tests/tui-input.test.ts, tests/tui-unicode.test.ts, tests/tui-safety.test.ts, tests/tui-screen.test.ts, tests/tui-components.test.ts, tests/tui-task.test.ts
verification.pty_smoke: packages/tui/examples/demo.ts under script(1) PTY: launch, key input, alt-screen enter/exit, clean exit verified
verification.resize: covered by unit tests (Renderer resize forces full redraw); live PTY resize not exercised in smoke
verification.install_mode_reachability: PASS (#237): `herdr plugin install rebuildup/herdr-plugins/plugins/inbox --ref 237` managed checkout is a full-repo clone; `../../../packages/tui` resolves and the pane rendered live on herdr 0.9.5 — see docs/research/inbox-tui-v237-live-verification.md

status_legend.cli: implemented = CLI command exists and is contract-covered
status_legend.tui_action: none = no manifest [[actions]] entry today; 'declared:<id>' = exists
status_legend.interactive_tui: implemented:#NNN = interactive TUI shipped in that ticket; planned:#NNN = scheduled in that implementation ticket; 'n/a' variants = not a human-interactive surface
status_legend.gui: GUI is owned by herdr-t3 (#7); this repo records consumption intent only — GUI-done NEVER implies TUI-done
status_legend.real_machine_evidence: paths under docs/research/ with live/real verification; absence does not imply untested, only no recorded real-machine run
status_legend.upstream_gap: non-null = blocked on herdr/T3Code upstream; never worked around by PTY guessing
